u0: No qualifying key-holding step has been recorded yet. The agent is not yet carrying the door-matching key, so the active subtask is to locate and pick up that key; the first step on which has_door_key is true will advance the RM to u1.
u1: One key-holding step has been recorded, but the target of two distinct key-holding steps has not yet been reached. If the agent is still carrying the matching key, keep holding it through another step to advance to u2; if the key was dropped before the door opened (a key_lost event), recover and reacquire it, because another step with has_door_key true is required.
u2: Terminal success state: the matching key has been held on at least two different steps. The RM task is complete, no further key-holding progress or reward is available, and later key drops or other actions do not change this state.
